description: This Kotlin source file defines the SmsManager class which provides functionality to send SMS messages and query SMS/MMS messages on Android devices. It handles permission checks, contact lookups, and interactions with the Android SMS/MMS content providers, including support for MMS threading and message metadata extraction.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: Provides functionality for sending SMS messages, querying SMS/MMS messages, handling permissions, and interacting with Android content providers to retrieve message and contact data.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to send SMS messages.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read SMS messages.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determines if the device supports SMS sending and has telephony features.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determines if the app has permission to search SMS messages.

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Checks if the device supports telephony features.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester instance for handling runtime permission requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SMS message based on the provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for SMS/MMS messages based on JSON query parameters.

methods.name: getPhoneNumbersFromContactName
methods.description: Resolves contact name to a list of normalized phone numbers.

methods.name: querySmsMessages
methods.description: Queries SMS messages matching the specified parameters and phone numbers.

methods.name: querySmsMmsMessagesByPhone
methods.description: Queries MMS/SMS messages associated with a specific phone number.

methods.name: getMmsTextBody
methods.description: Retrieves the text body of an MMS message.

methods.name: getMmsMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for MMS messages such as message box and read status.

methods.name: getMmsAddress
methods.description: Resolves and selects the appropriate address for an MMS message.
